name: cellA_v1x
about: cellA_v1 plus the orchestrator's cheap additions (#752 research, SUMMARY sections 4 and 8): lockstep decode with k = 2, 3, 4 DP ranks decoding at the same per-rank size (k = 1 is D-v1) and one uneven mix, for a lockstep / straggler term; and D-v1 repeated in the middle (A-mid) and at the end (A-end) of the record as anchors, so a per-record scale factor can be fitted and records pooled. Not in cellA_v1 itself: the law prices no lockstep term yet, so these segments add GPU time without moving the base gates.

segments.name: D-k2
segments.purpose: lockstep: two ranks decode at the same per-rank size

segments.name: D-k3
segments.purpose: lockstep: three ranks decode at the same per-rank size

segments.name: D-k4
segments.purpose: lockstep: four ranks decode at the same per-rank size

segments.purpose: lockstep: four ranks at 64, 32, 16 and 8 rows
